item.name: Rentalcarpet hire card
item.description: Annual subscription to the flying-carpet hire service. With this in hand, the nearest branch asks no questions.

item.name: Eight-cylinder flying carpet
item.description: Twin-turbo, collected from the Rentalcarpet branch. Between one entry and the next you can use it to catch up with Ali Baba.

item.name: The Genie's lamp
item.description: Lifted from Aladdin's belt. The Genie inside grants no wishes: he takes you back in time, and then leaves with the lamp.

item.name: Birdwatching call-whistle
item.description: Part of a birdwatching kit bought at the bazaar. It calls whatever flies, without telling a sparrow from a Roc.

item.name: Birdseed
item.description: Quality feed, bought together with the whistle. In the right baskets it attracts the wrong attention.
